name: Offering (Front Arm Raise)
summary: Kneeling with your back to the straps, long arms lift forward from the hips to shoulder height, palms up as if handing something over.
steps: Kneel facing the footbar, sitting on the heels; short loops, arms long by the sides, palms forward.
Breathe out to lift the arms forward to shoulder height.
Breathe in to lower with control.

layers.title: Open and close
layers.text: At shoulder height open the arms to the sides (stay just in front of the shoulders), close, then lower.

layers.title: Single arm with a twist
layers.text: One arm at a time, chest turning with it.

modifications: Sit on the long box for sore knees.
A little elbow bend on the way down for sore shoulders.

cautions.note: Lightest spring, stay below shoulder height.

cues:
Body stays still — no leaning forward to start the lift.
Wrists straight.
Ropes stay tight.
When kneeling up, keep the hips over the knees.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
